body.x: At CES 2025, Evenflo introduced SensorySoothe™, a groundbreaking innovation designed to soothe crying babies and reduce parental stress during travel. Unveiled at CES 2025 in Las Vegas, this first-of-its-kind technology integrates app-connected lights. It sounds directly into the handles of Evenflo’s newest premium car seats and travel systems, setting a new standard in the industry.

SensorySoothe allows parents to create a calming environment tailored to their child’s needs. Accessible via the Evenflo app, voice commands with Siri or Google, or on-unit buttons, this advanced system provides customizable light and sound combinations that leverage research on infant sensory preferences. SensorySoothe delivers a personalized experience to enhance infant comfort and parental peace of mind, from calming white noise and lullabies to dynamic light effects synchronized with sound.

“Any parent has been there—stuck in a car or public place with a crying baby, feeling helpless. SensorySoothe aims to alleviate stress in those moments,” said Sharon Ruggieri, Senior Director of Product Management at Evenflo. “It’s all about making parents’ lives easier and creating a calming environment wherever you go, tailored to your family’s needs.”

Beyond convenience, SensorySoothe enhances safety by integrating soothing features directly into the car seat, eliminating the need for aftermarket attachments that could become hazardous in the event of a crash. Sarah Haverstick, Senior Manager of Safety Advocacy & Consumer Care at Evenflo, emphasized, “With built-in lights and sounds, parents no longer need to rely on add-ons, ensuring babies are entertained and safe during travel.”

body.x: SensorySoothe will debut in two new premium products: the Shyft™ Intuiti™+ Travel System and the Revolve180™ LiteMax™ NXT. Both are designed to accommodate preemies and infants from 3 to 30 pounds and feature sustainable Green & Gentle™ Fabric made from recycled plastic bottles, free of added chemicals. The Revolve180 LiteMax NXT includes a gentle amber nightlight for nighttime travel and provides over 15 hours of battery life with four AA batteries, making it ideal for extended trips.

Available in six modern colors, these products will begin shipping in mid-February 2025 through online retailers such as Babylist, Amazon, Target, and Walmart. With SensorySoothe, Evenflo reaffirms its commitment to continuous innovation, making travel safer, more convenient, and less stressful for families.
